svg.title: PodVigil architecture
svg.desc: A local controller and detached watchdog preserve each attempt's ledger. The wait command reads a ledger without cloud access or changing the job. Optional capacity retries require a definite no-capacity answer and verified absence, then poll the catalog before another attempt. The controller manages an owned Runpod Secure Cloud Pod through the provider API. Inside the Pod a privileged guard supervises an unprivileged workload and snapshots local outputs to a private network volume. A local backup is verified before that volume can be deleted.
svg.text: Owned compute, independent supervision, durable results
